descriptionHtml:
Bug B01 · P0 · new

Photo census scan never finds anyone: the vision model wraps its JSON in a ```json block and parseModelJson (convex/lib/modelJson.ts:98) silently returns nothing (Hospital and Nursing Home)

Tickets: TFA-94425 ready for qa; TFA-92580 rejected by qa; TFA-92587 AC 3 ready for qa · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: dev + local

Note: Also blocks dev U77; U78–U81 paused for the same reason Review 2026-10-14 (TFA-92587): it also blocks every Nursing Home scan case on dev (TC-09/S04, S06, S07, S08, S17, S18; dev units U77–U81 paused).

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): OAT-03/S18, TC-09/S04, TC-09/S07, TC-09/S08, TC-09/S17, TC-09/S18

Approach · TC-09 All Residents Attendance Toggle (Nursing Home only) · S06 Photo row × All Residents state → outcome

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U2 Photographing the nursing supervisor's list adds the residents on it to Today's Visits. Residents already in All Residents go onto today's list, and new ones are created. (UAT TC-09; TFA-92587 AC 3; TFA-92587 How it works 3)
  • U3 The photo uses the same deduplication against All Residents as TC-02. Before anything is written, the physician sees how many residents are already known and how many are new (e.g. … (UAT TC-09; UAT TC-02 (by reference); TFA-92587 AC 3)
  • U7 New residents, whether added by photo or by hand, land in All Residents as Follow-up (TC-06 defaults). (UAT TC-09; UAT TC-06 (by reference); TFA-92587 AC 5; TFA-92587 How it works 5)
  • U8 Nursing Home only. Hospital has no attendance toggle, no Today's Visits / All Residents tabs and no supervisor-list photo. (UAT TC-09 (title); UAT 3.3; TFA-92587 AC 7)
  • U10 The supervisor-list scan writes only what the photo shows: a field that is not on the photo (MRN, unit, DOB) stays blank and is never generated, and the scan lists no row that is not on the photo. (UAT TC-02 ('a scan never invents an MRN or room; a field the photo didn't have is left blank'); UAT 3.4)

Test design technique: Decision table (decision-table) — List the combinations of several conditions and check each one, to see that the result follows the rule.

Given All Residents: QA Fir (Birch 1, In Today), QA Gum (Birch 2, not In Today), QA Hazel (Birch 3, not In Today), all Follow-up, plus the fixture resident (In Today, MRN 'QA-<tag>-10'). Hospital list: QA Ivy. No date of birth anywhere (D5)

When Scan a photo that mixes every row class, answer any review question as the goal says, confirm, then check Today's Visits, All Residents and the Hospital list

Then Known and already In Today (Fir): stays on today, once. Known and not In Today (Gum): joins today, not duplicated, unit unchanged. New (Juniper): created once, Follow-up, on today. Same row twice on the photo (Juniper): one resident, not two. Row with no DOB and no Unit (Kestrel): created with those fields blank and no generated MRN. …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs on s06-sheet ('7 residents found': no extra or missing row), s06-today, s06-all, s06-kestrel-chart and s06-hospital (U2, U3, U7, U8, U10). Today's Visits checkpoints mustNotContain 'In Today ✓' and All Residents ones mustContain it. s06-all mustNotContain New Admission / Consult: every seed is Follow-up, so a new resident with another badge fails (U7). …

Where it ran: dev unit U79; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S06 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-09.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 0 rows.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: API · API (Convex functions) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
